body:
[A10] Found by [A274] while adopting `a8f8ce81` in kebag-logic/milan-fpga #508 (branch `508-pp-pin-adopt`, head `35f06958`). The parent cannot pin this processor main.

## Observed

Three gates in the parent's required `docs-check` context refuse processor content that is new since the parent's current pin `09f9bf38`. At that pin the parent's `docs.yml` is green. Each gate's rules forbid the parent from adding the identity or raising the ratchet, so the fix belongs here.

| Parent gate | Finding | Source | Remedy |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scripts/check_port_contracts.py` | 7 literal-bound connections with no rationale: `hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv` `u_nvm_arb.{m1_req_i, m1_we_i, m1_rid_i, m1_wvalid_i, m1_wdata_i, m1_rready_i, m1_abort_i}` | PR #109 | put the rationale directly above each literal connection run |
| `scripts/measure_naming.py --check` | 2 new identities: `KL_aecp_desc_mem_guard:s_rsp_data_o` ("response bytes, unchanged") and `protocol_processor_top:srp_sr_admitted_o` (the comment quotes a latency in clocks) | PR #110, PR #114 | reword the two `//!` comments so they document no unit the name lacks |
| `scripts/measure_test_evidence.py --check` | wall-clock-dependent suite files 6 > ratchet 3: `tb/desc_mem_guard/mutate.py`, `tb/pp_top/gsi_mutants.py`, `tb/srp_admission/mutants.py` pass `timeout=` to `subprocess.run` | PR #110, #111, #114 | drop the host deadlines, since the legs are cycle-bounded |

The seven-gate parent consumer check that the manager ran for #109 to #114 did not include these gates. The donor bar now runs the parent's full builder bank.

## Acceptance

1. In a parent consumer (milan-fpga dev with this head as the gitlink), all three gates exit 0. The parent adds no identity and raises no ratchet.
2. No behaviour change: every suite's check count and every mutation campaign's verdict table are identical before and after. For each dropped deadline, show the run terminates by construction (cycle bound or iteration bound).
3. The processor's own gates pass.

Executor: [A284]. Reviewers: [R314] internal, [R315] external.
title: Parent docs-check gates refuse three constructs added since 09f9bf38
